=== a chat calls wait_for
chat: wait_for {"tasks":["T05"]}
refusal:
wait_for is the orchestrator's: it says when its own next turn starts. A chat on the run does not wait; get_run shows what is running.

=== no tasks given
orchestrator: wait_for {}
refusal:
tasks must be a list of task ids, with at least one

=== tasks is not a list
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":"T05"}
refusal:
tasks must be a list of task ids, with at least one

=== tasks is a list of other things
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":[5]}
refusal:
tasks must be a list of task ids, with at least one

=== an empty list
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":[]}
refusal:
tasks must be a list of task ids, with at least one

=== a mode that is none
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T05"],"mode":"first"}
refusal:
mode must be all or any

=== tasks that do not exist
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T05","T9","T10"]}
refusal:
there is no task 'T9', 'T10' (the run has tasks T01 to T06)

=== tasks that have ended
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T01","T05","T03"]}
refusal:
T01 (done), T03 (failed) already ended, so there is nothing to wait for: its result is there to read now (get_task). Name only tasks that are pending or running.

=== all of two, one named twice
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T05","T02","T05"]}
answer:
After this turn the next instance starts when all of T05, T02 ended, or earlier if a task fails, nothing is left running, or a chat on the run changes it.

=== again in the same turn: the last one holds
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T06","T04","T05"],"mode":"any"}
answer:
After this turn the next instance starts when any of T06, T04, T05 ended, or earlier if a task fails, nothing is left running, or a chat on the run changes it.

=== a refused call leaves the wait as it is
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T01"]}
refusal:
T01 (done) already ended, so there is nothing to wait for: its result is there to read now (get_task). Name only tasks that are pending or running.

=== mode all, given
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T05"],"mode":"all"}
answer:
After this turn the next instance starts when all of T05 ended, or earlier if a task fails, nothing is left running, or a chat on the run changes it.

=== the run's wake mode is each
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T02"]}
refusal:
unknown tool wait_for

=== the run's wake mode is each, a chat
chat: wait_for {"tasks":["T02"]}
refusal:
wait_for is the orchestrator's: it says when its own next turn starts. A chat on the run does not wait; get_run shows what is running.

=== the run's wake mode is idle
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T02"]}
refusal:
unknown tool wait_for

=== no wake mode recorded counts as declared
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T02"],"mode":""}
answer:
After this turn the next instance starts when all of T02 ended, or earlier if a task fails, nothing is left running, or a chat on the run changes it.

=== the run is stopping
orchestrator: wait_for {"tasks":["T05"]}
refusal:
the run is stopping; try again when it has stopped
